note: The third site of the same defect: codegen.generate refuses a #steps budget outside 1..50,000,000 and writes the number into the message. Note the shape of the family -- decimal literals are stopped in the lexer before they reach any of these, so all three are reachable ONLY through hex, which has no conversion limit on the way in and the full one on the way out.
signature: ValueError in codegen.generate: Exceeds the limit (N digits) for integer string conversion;
